metadata.domain: AI Vision Perception / ADAS / Computer Vision

evidence.trl_pathway: All three technologies start at TRL 5-6 and have 2-year development windows, which is reasonable for incremental advancement; however, T04 has a 0-quarter development window (2030-Q1 to 2030-Q1) suggesting no actual development time allocated after its prerequisite completes, which is unrealistic.
evidence.strategic_fidelity: The 기술선도 strategy calls for exploratory, lower-TRL, R&D-heavy portfolios, but all selected technologies are mid-to-high TRL (5-6) and the portfolio is relatively small (3 technologies); the selections lean more toward commercialization readiness than true technology leadership exploration.
evidence.competitive_awareness: All three technologies are well within the AI Vision/ADAS/Computer Vision domain — sensor fusion, driver monitoring, and synthetic data pipelines are core competencies for this space — demonstrating good domain coherence and competitive positioning awareness.
evidence.market_timing: Two of three technologies complete significantly after their market boom windows: T01 completes 2.5 years late and T02 completes 1.25 years late; only T04 is reasonably close (1 year late), and for 기술선도 strategy the target should be 1-2 years BEFORE boom, making the systematic lateness a critical flaw.
evidence.patent_market_convergence: The selected technologies are in areas of known patent and market activity convergence (generative AI for data, sensor fusion, driver monitoring), but there is no explicit evidence in the roadmap that convergence-zone targeting was intentional versus coincidental given the lack of patent-trend analysis documentation.

strengths: All technologies are domain-coherent and form a logical dependency chain (synthetic data → sensor fusion → driver state monitoring) that builds capability progressively.
Budget is fully utilized with zero violations and dependency ordering is correctly respected throughout the roadmap.
weaknesses: Systematic market timing lag — all three technologies complete after their boom windows, with T01 missing by 2.5 years, which is particularly damaging for competitive advantage.
T04 (시선 추적 기반 운전자 상태 인지) has a zero-duration development window (2030-Q1 to 2030-Q1), indicating an implementation planning error that makes its execution infeasible.
missing_technologies: Transformer-based end-to-end perception models (lower TRL, higher R&D intensity — better fits 기술선도 profile)
Neuromorphic or event-driven vision sensing (emerging, patent-dense, aligns with technology leadership ambition)
Federated learning for distributed ADAS perception (cross-cutting enabler for the domain with high patent activity)
investment_issues: T04 is rated Tier=High with below-average scores across all dimensions (3.0) yet is still funded, while no exploratory/speculative technologies are included to fulfill the 기술선도 mandate.
Both T01 and T02 are classified as Tier=Strategic despite T01 having high uncertainty (4.0) and late market timing, suggesting tier classification does not adequately penalize timing risk.
timing_issues: T01 (시각-레이더 융합 센서 아키텍처) completes in 2030-Q1, but the market boom peaks at 2027-Q3 — a 2.5-year miss that forfeits first-mover advantage entirely.
T02 (생성형 AI 기반 합성 데이터 파이프라인) completes 1.25 years after its 2026-Q4 boom, meaning competitors will have matured this capability before this roadmap delivers it.
For a 기술선도 strategy, all completions should precede boom windows by 1-2 years; instead all three are late, inverting the strategic intent.
